deployments_detail.use: AI-driven antibacterial drug discovery: Viatris entered a research collaboration with Locus Biosciences to develop precision engineered bacteriophage therapeutics for serious ophthalmic infections, using Locus's platform that integrates predictive AI, high-throughput robotics and synthetic biology to design phage cocktails. [Locus Biosciences (AI-powered phage engineering platform)]

AI-powered clinical intelligence: Viatris states a collaboration strengthening AI-powered clinical intelligence capabilities within its care-delivery model to help support clinicians (details of partner/scope not disclosed in the post). [none]

Internal AI Hackathon driven by global CIO Ramkumar Rayapureddy: 300+ participants across the global technology team generated 120+ ideas/prototypes spanning workflow automation, analytics and intelligent decision-making, moving AI from concept to buildable internal tools. [none]
Salesforce Agentforce AI + automation/analytics across commercial segments/channels/geographies

Approval workflow automation: a solution built on SAP Build Process Automation to orchestrate approval workflows with a unified inbox for managing all approval tasks (recognized as a 2026 SAP Innovation Awards entry), plus SAP Integration Suite for email integration. [SAP (Build Process Automation, Integration Suite / BTP)]

AI virtual assistant for pharmacy/customer support: an always-on AI agent that answers FAQs, handles pharmacy support requests and provides order information as part of Viatris's reimagined global customer engagement operations. [Salesforce (Agentforce)]

Global customer engagement platform: Viatris deployed Salesforce Agentforce Life Sciences for Customer Engagement across 165+ countries/territories to run field-visit management, event logistics, HCP interaction tracking and approval workflows for its commercial, medical and patient-support teams (offline-sync mobile/tablet field app). [Salesforce (Agentforce Life Sciences, Customer 360 / Data 360)]

AI-driven multichannel marketing: Viatris uses Agentforce Marketing to deliver personalized campaigns to healthcare professionals across email, SMS and digital channels as part of its unified Customer 360 engagement. [Salesforce (Agentforce Marketing)]

Commercial productivity AI program (LATAM): Viatris is staffing a LATAM Commercial Productivity & AI Specialist to identify, develop and implement AI and automation solutions that simplify processes, enhance commercial effectiveness and enable data-driven decision-making, tracking efficiency gains and business impact. [none]
